commit_message: Resolve stable SpriteRefs for Native 2D rendering
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Resolves SpriteRenderer2D stable SpriteRefs through immutable SpriteAtlas regions and CPU-decoded source textures while keeping GPU handles and UV packing derived-only; also exposes Project2dSettings as the shared runtime render/physics policy resource.
